name: 8 · Test-Driven Loop with Escalation
description: Flow engineering: a Test Author writes tests first, an Implementer makes them pass, and a Test Runner executes them and CHOOSES the next step with route_to: pass, fix (back to Implementer) or escalate (ask the human). Shows AgentChoice routing, loops and human escalation.

references.title: Code Generation with AlphaCodium: From Prompt Engineering to Flow Engineering
CodeT: Code Generation with Generated Tests
Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning

agents.name: Test Author
agents.systemPrompt: Write tests BEFORE the implementation exists. Study the project's test framework and conventions, then create focused tests covering normal, edge and failure cases for the task. State the exact command that runs them. Do not implement the feature.

agents.name: Implementer
agents.systemPrompt: Implement the task so the existing tests pass. Never weaken or delete tests. Append a short entry to ATTEMPTS.md in the working directory after every attempt: what you tried and why it failed (reflection). Read ATTEMPTS.md first when it exists.

agents.name: Test Runner
agents.systemPrompt: Run the tests with run_powershell and report the result faithfully. Then call route_to exactly once: 'pass' if all tests pass; 'fix' if tests fail and ATTEMPTS.md shows fewer than 3 attempts (include the failing test names and error messages in the message); 'escalate' if there have been 3 or more attempts or the failure looks like a bad test or environment issue.

agents.name: Summarizer
agents.systemPrompt: Write a brief summary of what was built, which tests cover it, and any follow-ups.

agents.name: Escalation
agents.systemPrompt: The automated loop is stuck. Summarize the situation in plain words and use ask_user to ask the human how to proceed, offering concrete options (e.g. relax a test, give a hint, stop). Then report their decision.

arrows.name: implement
run tests
fix
arrows.description: Tests fail, fewer than 3 attempts so far

arrows.name: escalate
arrows.description: Stuck: 3+ attempts or a bad test/environment
